name: Mathystra Relics
summary: Along Darkshore's northeastern coast, Mathystra Relics may reveal how the Twilight's Hammer bends ancient elven magic. Onu, an Ancient of Lore in the Grove of the Ancients, seeks them to learn what the cult intends.

sections.title: A Disturbing Discovery
sections.body: After you recovered a tainted parchment from Twilight's Hammer cultists near the Master's Glaive, Onu deciphered its meaning. The writing was not the cult's own. It was a cursed fragment of ancient night elven script, tainted by the Twilight's Hammer. The zealots are using forgotten elven magic to awaken or summon their ancient masters into the mortal world.

sections.title: The Fallen Bastion
sections.body: Onu sends you to the Ruins of Mathystra on Darkshore's northeastern shore. Before the Sundering, Mathystra was a shining bastion of highborne civilization. The city fell to rubble, weeds and naga, yet its old enchantments endure in shattered urns and relics scattered among the stone foundations.

sections.title: Divining Dark Designs
sections.body: You gather surviving relics from the grassy debris so the defenders of Darkshore can learn which arts the cult means to use. Onu studies the magic left in each piece. He must uncover the cult's plans before the Twilight's Hammer bends ancient kaldorei sorcery to free its subterranean masters.

faq.answer: The Mathystra Relics are fragments of enchanted pottery, urns and artifacts from the ruins. They were made during the height of ancient night elven civilization before the Great Sundering, and still hold lingering magic.

faq.q: Why does Onu want these relics?
faq.answer: Onu wants the relics because the Twilight's Hammer is using ancient elven magic to bring its dark masters back into the world. By studying intact pieces from Mathystra, he hopes to learn how the cult will wield that power.

faq.q: Where were the Ruins of Mathystra located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Mathystra lie along Darkshore's northeastern coast, north of Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran and just past the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: Who is the Twilight's Hammer trying to bring back?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer seeks to bring back its ancient, malevolent masters. Onu warns that the cult is using ancient elven magic to return them to Azeroth.

faq.q: What was Mathystra before it became a ruin?
faq.answer: Mathystra was once a great night elven city and bastion, thousands of years ago. The Great Sundering left it in ruins, and wilderness, ghosts and vile beach-dwelling creatures such as the naga overran it.
Onu gives you the Mathystra Relics task. He is an ancient treant rooted in the Grove of the Ancients in south-central Darkshore, after your investigation of the Master's Glaive.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see relics of your people's pre-Sundering glory dug from the dirt. Their fall is a somber reminder, and the Twilight's Hammer's use of your ancestors' potent arts is an alarming warning.
As a druid, you aid Onu, one of nature's greatest elder sentinels. You help safeguard Darkshore's ancient history from dark cultists.
As an Alliance member, you help keep northern Kalimdor safe from dark forces beneath the earth by preventing the Twilight's Hammer from weaponizing ancient magic.
